title: Eliciting step-by-step reasoning from LLMs via prompting alone
description: Large language models tend to emit a final answer directly, which hurts them on tasks requiring multiple reasoning steps (arithmetic word problems, symbolic and commonsense reasoning). As of the source work, prompting a frozen pretrained LLM with input-output exemplars did not induce it to reveal intermediate steps. No prompting technique existed that makes the model generate an explicit step-by-step reasoning trace before its final answer, using only in-context exemplars - no fine-tuning, parameter updates, or external tools.
canonical_description: no prompting method elicits explicit intermediate reasoning steps from a frozen LLM

evidence.quote: GPT-3 still struggles with multi-step arithmetic and commonsense reasoning under few-shot prompting.
